snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories Series – Broadcast Trailer | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, the next evolution in the turn-based RPG, story-rich Monster Hunter Stories series, comes to Xbox on March 13, 2026! Get ready for this new adventure by seeing where it all began with the first two beloved entries in the series when Monster Hunter Stories and Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruins soar to Xbox One for the first time on November 14, 2025.
